seed_variation.accounts: same v4 selection accounts; reporting only, never used for setting selection
seed_variation.target_sampler: same uniform positive Linux target sampler and original role namespace as v4 split
seed_variation.denominator: same accounts in each seed; report primary and short-history strata separately
seed_variation.uncertainty: average each user's outcomes across seeds before paired user resampling; never treat user x seed rows as independent

hidden_negative.accounts: primary v4 selection accounts with at least one visible negative Linux game
hidden_negative.sample: one uniform negative Linux game from original visible query; SHA256 counter rejection seed20261108 namespace steam-v4-hidden-negative
hidden_negative.query: keep the positive target hidden and additionally remove sampled negative from query and exclusion mask; retain all selected users even if remaining total inputs become4
hidden_negative.score: fraction of selected users with hidden negative in top10; lower is better; one negative per user
hidden_negative.interpretation: reporting only; not false-positive rate over all unobserved games, not a model selection criterion

finalist: at most one variant frozen by the primary selection before these reporting outcomes
cold_start: separate item-removal retraining protocol required before a new-game performance claim
confirmation: never opened by these supplementary diagnostics
